title: OS Window Style for Print
description: Port OS window chrome styling into print LaTeX framework: chrome tokens, semio-window.sty, chapter/section auto-windowing.
summary:
Navbar and footer chrome now use page background (`chrome.base`) instead of window color (`chrome.window`), matching OS shell `bg-base` behavior.

Changes:
- `print/script.ts`: emit `semio-chrome-*-base` tokens from `chrome.base`.
- `print/tex/semio-core.sty`: theme alias `semio-chrome-base`.
- `print/tex/semio-window.sty`: navbar/footer bars and chips use `semio-chrome-base`.
- `print/tex/semio-tokens.sty`: regenerated with base paint tokens.

Verified: `bun ./📜️script.ts build zwischenbericht` succeeds for light and dark PDFs.
